notes.title: Steam Scream Fest 3D - Cards of the Dead is on sale!
notes.notes:
[h3]🧟‍♂️ The zombies are coming to Steam Scream Fest 3D! 🧟‍♀️[/h3]

Steam Scream Fest 3D starts today, and it’s the perfect time to grab Cards of the Dead, a game that mixes survival mechanics with cards! 🎴💀

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1592230?utm_source=jandu&utm_campaign=steamscream2024&utm_medium=steamevent

If you want more terrifying stories check out the exclusive [b]Boomfire Bundle[/b] and save an extra 10% on The Creepy Syndrome & Cards of the Dead!

Steam Scream Fest 3D ends on November 4th! 📅

[h3]👇 Buy the bundle here and save an extra 10%! 👇[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/32224/Boomfire_Games/

notes.title: Card of the Dead - Steam Scream Fest
notes.notes:
[b]Welcome to spooktober![/b]

Steam Scream Fest is here and you can [b]save 50%[/b] on your purchase of [b]Cards of the Dead[/b].

Get this survival card game now at an unbeatable price. Play your cards right and you can escape the zombie apocalypse!

This special event is only available until November 1st.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1592230/Cards_of_the_Dead/

notes.title: Update 1.0.3
notes.notes:
- Implemented windowed mode (requested by some streamers)
- Added a checkpoint before Selena's boss fight
- Fixed issue where the player was unable to progress when entering a boss fight without a weapon in hand or in the bag.

notes.title: Steam Next Fest - Special Stream Event
notes.notes:
On Wednesday, June 16th, at 10 AM Pacific, right at the start of the Steam Next Fest, our community team jumps in to play Nine to Five, discuss the Next Fest, and answer your questions!

Tune in if you want to beat us at our own game, have a laugh, or if you want to see what the game looks like before playing it yourself!

With thousands of titles around the globe, Steam presents the world's largest and most varied selection of games with an attractive live program. [i]The Steam Next Fest[/i]

And [b]Cards of the Dead[/b] is one of the selected games.

In order to celebrate it, we are going to stream 24/7 and let the users play our game in a public demo.

And this is not the only surprise we've got in store for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40252099/8dfc52ac6bd8271165bc2d1d52526682d6685ea1.png[/img]
